c1.note: Samsung's own release states KRW 333.6 trillion in annual revenue for FY2025, still the latest completed fiscal year.

c2.note: The release is dated Korea, January 29, 2026.

c3.note: Revenue rose 10.9% to 333.6T, above the 2024 figure of 300.9T. Samsung's release does not say 'highest annual ever', but earlier years such as 2022 (about 302T) were lower, so it holds for completed years.

c4.note: The release gives full-year operating profit of KRW 43.6 trillion, and Yonhap adds the 33.2% rise.

c5.note: Yonhap: operating profit of 43.6T, up 33.2% from the prior year.

c6.note: Yonhap: annual sales rose 10.9% to 333.6T won.

c8.note: The release gives Q4 2025 revenue of 93.8T as a record quarter. It has since been surpassed by Q3 2026 (195.25T).

c9.note: The release states a 9% quarter-on-quarter increase.

c10.note: The release gives Q4 operating profit of 20.1T as an all-time high at the time. Q3 2026 is far higher.

c11.note: Yonhap: net income of 45.2T won (US$31.6B), up 31.2%.

c12.note: 45.2T won = US$31.6B implies about 1,430 won per dollar. 333.6T divided by 1,430 gives about US$233B, and it is labelled an estimate.

c13.note: The PDF text is unreadable here, but 333,605,938 million is consistent with the reported 333.6T.

c14.note: Not directly visible in the passages. It is consistent with a convenience-translation rate of about 1,422 won per dollar, which also fits the 2024 pair.

c15.note: The 2024 revenue of 300.87T won matches known results, and the USD figure uses the same rate as the 2025 pair.

c17.note: Samsung's Oct 29, 2026 release states KRW 195.3T consolidated revenue, an all-time quarterly high, up 14% QoQ.

c18.note: The release states operating profit of KRW 107.4T and that it is the first tech company above KRW 100T in quarterly operating profit.

c19.note: CNBC gives revenue of 195.25T won ($124B) vs 195.79T expected, up 126.88% YoY.

c20.note: The Q3 release says the board will decide shareholder returns at a meeting in late January 2027, with an announcement to follow, and FY2025 results were released on Jan 29, so FY2026 results in late January 2027 are consistent. c21.note: Q3 2026 revenue alone (195.3T) is far above the FY2025 quarterly run rate (Q4 2025 was 93.8T), so FY2026 will exceed 333.6T by a wide margin.

c22.note: Samsung's fiscal year ends Dec 31, so as of Nov 11, 2026 FY2025 (KRW 333.6T) is the latest completed year.

c23.note: The release states KRW 333.6T as full-year revenue for FY2025.

c24.note: The KRW 333.6T figure is Samsung Electronics' consolidated revenue and not Samsung Group-wide.

c25.note: The Fast Facts page says 'Based on FY 2025 consolidated statements' and lists revenue of 333.6.

c27.note: Q3 2026 results were released on Oct 29, 2026, and Q3 is only reported after Q1 and Q2 results.

c16.note: The saved FY2025 statements PDF shows no date. A search found the auditor's report on the year-end statements dated Feb 12, 2026, as cited in Samsung's 2026 quarterly review reports. This is background and does not state the revenue figure.

c26.note: The claim is flagged as unverified and no saved page gives a USD revenue figure. Yonhap's net-income conversion implies about 1,430 KRW/USD, so KRW 333.6T is roughly $233B, inside the stated range. This is an approximate conversion, not a primary-source figure.
